faqs.a:
Pursuant to the provisions of C.R.S. § 29-11-101 et seq., as amended, there is hereby
               imposed upon all telephone exchange access facilities within the city an emergency
               telephone charge per exchange access facility, whenever and for such period of time
               as the Jefferson County Emergency Telephone Service Authority deems appropriate, in
               an amount up to and including $0.40 per exchange access facility or two percent of
               the tariff rate as defined in C.R.S. § 29-11-102(2), whichever at any point in time
               is lower. Upon recommendation of the Jefferson County Emergency Telephone Service
               Authority, the city council may, by resolution, raise or lower the emergency telephone
               charge, but in no event shall such charge exceed the amount authorized by the tariff
               as approved by the state public utilities commission.
(Code 1981, § 2-194; Ord. No. 2116, § 1, 10-15-1984; Ord. No. 2247, § 1, 12-2-1985)
